lessons.title: 6. Aggregate Functions
lessons.description: Calculate total order revenue with SUM(total_amount) and average order value with AVG(total_amount) from orders.
lessons.starter_code:
-- TODO: compute total revenue and average order value from orders
SELECT 0 AS total_revenue, 0 AS avg_order WHERE 0;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_order FROM orders;

source.name: SQLite official documentation (sqlite.org) — Aggregate functions — avg() 'returns the average value of all non-NULL X within a group'

learning_objectives: Summarize a whole table with SUM(), AVG() and COUNT()
Give aggregate results readable names with AS aliases
